### Testgrid link

https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-release-master-blocking#gce-master-scale-performance-100&exclude-non-failed-tests=

### Reason for failure (if possible)

The job fails before cluster creation because the kubetest2 binary does not recognize the --metadata option:
```
Error: unknown flag: --metadata
```
Example raw log:

https://storage.googleapis.com/kubernetes-ci-logs/logs/ci-kubernetes-e2e-gce-scale-performance-100/2105274704653717504/build-log.txt

The failed executions do not produce JUnit results, so there is no corresponding Kubernetes Triage cluster.


### Anything else we need to know?


This job started immediately after kubernetes/kops#18802 merged on September 30, 2026:

https://github.com/kubernetes/kops/pull/18802

That change stopped building kubetest2 during periodic jobs and added `--metadata=variant=base` to the kubetest2 invocation.

The outcome depends on the cached kubekins-e2e image available on the Prow worker:

Failed runs use image digest `sha256:12253530c9812be72b1990d85faf87669bb4d998bb8ace00c03eaa1d26b0f686`. Its kubetest2 binary does not support --metadata.

Passing runs use image digest `sha256:470d142cc9b342a49937ac63b76851b9aad305f235b4543d340f6e2cf241b8bc`, containing kubetest2 version 339cd250dc8b779d350f6eb8db57f4fa60ed3784.

Both digests are referenced through the same image tag, and the job uses `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent`. This makes the result depend on which Prow worker executes the job.

Passing and failing runs are currently interleaved, confirming that this remains flaky. The job image should be bumped or pinned to an image containing a compatible kubetest2 binary.

### Relevant SIG(s)

/sig scalability
/sig cluster-lifecycle
/kind flake
